cal FXS (Foreign Exchange Station) ports on a voice gateway unit (such as a Cisco VG series high-density analog gateway or VG310/224) that terminate directly on the analog inputs of the Bogen UTI312 multi-zone paging controller and localized amplifiers. • Dialing Method: Users dial specific 4-digit directory extensions (e.g., x2222 or x1243) from their desk phones.
